decisions.issues: v03 (the only listed candidate) gives Nagoji two right arms coming off one near shoulder. One is bent, its forearm folded up so the hand closes on Revathi's wrist, with the elbow at the left edge of the rib bandage. The other runs straight down past it to a fist planted on the mat. No upper arm crosses his chest, so the gripping arm cannot be his left, which stays hidden under the shoulder cloth on the far side. At native size this reads plainly as an extra limb. Everything else works: her hand on his bare right shoulder above the bandage, the shoulder cloth slipped, his face (curled moustache, clean chin, gold stud, no grey), Revathi's widow costume with no red dot, the barred window and door, the night palette, and clear dark wall above them for the balloon.
decisions.correction: Nagoji must have exactly two arms, each joined to its own shoulder, and both shown clearly. Draw him half-reclining on the mat, propped on his far LEFT elbow (that arm and hand partly under the slipped white shoulder cloth on the side away from Revathi), so no arm props him on the near side. decisions.issues: Clean. v03 fixes the round 1 and 2 guard failure. Both Nair guards are bare-chested in plain white mundus with no sash. Minor: Nagoji's grey at the temples is a visible silver streak, a little stronger than 'faint', but it matches 19.3. Captions fit over the plain upper-left wall and ceiling area above the guards' heads, and along the top rafter band.
